component.name: ProbeScene
component.script: sub init() chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.,-'" for each font in ["ExtraLargeSystemFont", "ExtraLargeBoldSystemFont"] for i = 1 to Len(chars) for j = 1 to Len(chars) if i <> j then label = m.top.CreateChild("Label") label.id = font label.font = "font:" + font label.text = String(10, Mid(chars, i, 1)) + String(10, Mid(chars, j, 1)) end if end for end for end for end sub
